Anya P.: Morning — async standup from me. What I did: landed kernel scheduling change to prefer short-seq microbatches, tweaked batcher backoff, and added KV cache hit-rate gauges to the runtime metrics.

Anya P.: Blockers: perf numbers are noisy on canary — seeing tail latency spikes after a ~1k token run. I suspect warmup + slot reuse. CI repro is flaky.

Kevin L.: noted. can you paste the bench command you used? I'll try repro locally on the 3090 rig.

Anya P.: sure — ran: ```./bench_runner --model rwd-medium --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --warmup 200 --iters 400``` Also tried `--prefetch=1` and `--prefetch=2` variants.

Kevin L.: thanks. will run with --warmup 500 and check backend logs for batch alignment. if it's slot reuse maybe we need a short eviction window.

Sophie R.: heads up — if we change eviction windows we should gate with a rollout flag. last time early evict caused a small regression on QA. can we add canary with 5% traffic first? :eyes:

Anya P.: agree on canary. planning 4-step rollout: local smoke -> canary 5% -> canary 25% -> global. need review on PR 2487 (kernel scheduling + metrics). pinging @Kevin L. for review.

Jordan M.: FYI ops: schedule looks good. we have a dedicated maintenance window tomorrow 09:00 UTC if you want to coordinate rollout and longer warmup tests.

Anya P.: perfect — will schedule extended runs then. quick question: KV cache TTL tweak I tried (180s -> 120s) improved hit contiguity for short jobs but reduced long-run hit-rate. any strong preferences?

Kevin L.: leaning to keep TTL adaptive by seq-distribution rather than fixed. small patch idea: track 95p seq length per model and set TTL = clamp( base * (95p/512), 60, 600 ).

Sophie R.: that sounds sensible. can you sketch it in a small RFC or inline PR description? make sure you include fallout cases for multi-tenant models.

Anya P.: will add RFC to PR and include perf-bot baseline. also adding stacked-chart to dashboard for per-model KV hit vs latency.

perf-bot: Benchmark run 1748900012: rwd-medium seq=1024 conc=8 warmup=200 iters=400 -> median latency 42.3ms, 95p 210.7ms, tokens/sec 640. Notes: tail jitter correlated with cache-miss bursts.

Kevin L.: looks like the bot saw similar tail. I'll follow up with a trace from canary run and /logs grep for `slot_reassign` events.

Jordan M.: minor ops note: if you need extra 3090 nodes for longer runs tomorrow, ping infra and mention "microstride-warmup" to get priority.

Anya P.: thanks — will do. Next: today I'll open the PR for adaptive TTL, run the warmup-long tests in the maintenance window, and post results here. Blocker is still the flaky CI repro — if anyone sees that locally please drop logs. :thumbsup:
